WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    sf.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.entrystat AS access_status,
    AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
  GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    access_status,
    avg_traitcount,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS record_fraction
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT site_code, access_status, avg_traitcount, record_count, record_fraction
FROM ranked
ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
